title: Get the details of a comment mention from webhooks
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the details of a mention in a comment obtained from [the mentions webhook](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1825113658431489), enabling real-time monitoring of business mentions in comment threads. The mention can originate from a post comment or reply that mentions a business's handle. > **Note**
> Retrieve the details within 48 hours of receiving the webhook to ensure data availability. ## Before you start - Ensure the TikTok account is a TikTok Account with Advanced Access or Verified Business Account. Learn more [about TikTok account entitlements](https://ads.tiktok.com/resources/help/article/about-tiktok-account-entitlements). To confirm this, use [/business/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-profile-data-of-a-tiktok-account/v1.3) and check whether the response parameter `has_advanced_access` is `true` for the TikTok account. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/mention/comment/get/ **Method** GET **Required permission scopes**: `biz.brand.insights`, `comment.list` **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok accounts.

To obtain an access token, use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/mentions-api-authentication/v1.3#anchor-1).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | |business_id {Required}|string|Application specific unique identifier for the TikTok account.

You can get the ID through the `open_id` field returned by [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/mentions-api-authentication/v1.3#anchor-1).| |comment_id{Required}|string|The ID of the comment or reply that mentions a business in the comment text.

Pass the `comment_id` as obtained from `comment_id` within the [`content` of the mentions webhook event](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1825113658431489#item-link-Event%20content).| |item_id{Required}|string|The ID of the post on which the comment was published.

Pass the post ID as obtained from `video_id` within the [`content` of the mentions webhook event](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1825113658431489#item-link-Event%20content).| |fields|string[]|Requested fields.
If `fields` is not set, only the default fields will be returned.

Default value: `["comment_id","comment_text"]`.

Supported fields:
  • `item_id`: Unique identifier for the post.
  • `video_link`: A generic URL for the post.
  • `video_likes`: Total number of likes on the post.
  • `thumbnail_url`: The URL of the post thumbnail.
  • `commenter_handle_name`: The handle name of the user who made the comment.
  • `comment_id`: Unique identifier for the comment.
  • `comment_type`: The type of comment.
  • `comment_text`: The comment text that mentions the business's handle.
  • `comment_create_time`: The time when the comment was posted.
  • `comment_likes`: Total number of likes for the comment.
| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/mention/comment/get/?business_id={{business_id}}&comment_id={{comment_id}}&item_id={{item_id}}&fields=["item_id","video_link","caption","video_likes","thumbnail_url","commenter_handle_name","comment_id","comment_type","comment_text","comment_create_time","comment_likes"]' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #|comment|object|Information about the mention in the comment.| ##|item_id|string|Unique identifier for the post.

Example: `6995316737801538821`.| ##|video_link|string|The generic URL of the post, in the format of https://www.tiktok.com/@/video/{item_id}.

Example: `https://www.tiktok.com/@/video/7231234123412341234`.| ##|video_likes|number|Total number of likes on the post.

Example: 243.| ##|thumbnail_url|string|The URL of the post thumbnail.

Validity period: 48 hours.
The expiration time is included in the URL after the `x-expires` parameter, in the format of an Epoch/Unix timestamp in seconds.

Example: `https://p16-sign-sg.tiktokcdn.com/tos-maliva-p-0068/1f9a445423844b82bd79317b42b9953f~c5_300x400.webp?x-expires=1614034800&x-signature=qChosOGafzBcTctPm9zYiF8Y2MA%3D"`.

Note: For TikTok photo posts, the value of this field will be an empty string (`""`).| ##|commenter_handle_name|string|The handle name of the user who made the comment.

Example: `angely`.| ##|comment_id|string|Unique identifier for the comment.

Example: `6990565363377392901`.| ##|comment_type|string|The type of comment.

Enum values:
  • `COMMENT`: Top-level comment.
  • `REPLY`: Comment reply.
| ##|comment_text|string|The comment text that mentions the brand's handle.

Example: `This is a comment #comment 🙂`.| ##|comment_create_time|string|Unix/epoch date-time when the comment was posted, in UTC timezone.

Example: `2025-04-01 06:49:10 +0000 UTC`.| ##|comment_likes|number|Total number of likes for the comment.

Example: 243.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "comment": { "video_link": "{{video_link}}", "item_id": "{{item_id}}", "video_likes": 101, "thumbnail_url": "{{thumbnail_url}}", "commenter_handle_name": "{{commenter_handle_name}}", "comment_id": "{{comment_id}}", "comment_likes": 0, "comment_text": "{{comment_text}}", "comment_create_time": "2025-04-29 06:11:59 +0000 UTC", "comment_type": "COMMENT" } } } (/code) ```
seo_title: Get the details of a TikTok comment mention from webhooks
seo_description: Use this endpoint to retrieve details of a mention in a comment from the mentions webhook, enabling  monitoring of business mentions in comment threads.
